Package hadur2.core.melee

Class MeleeProfileFolder

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.melee.MeleeProfileFolder
public final class MeleeProfileFolder extends Object
One round's melee observations of each opponent, waiting to join its MeleeProfile when the round ends (MMEM-1). The MeleeController feeds it from the events it already handles: every shot the tracker infers from an energy drop (MSENSE-2), with its power; every hit on Hadur, credited to the shooter and classed head-on or leading when Hadur's path at the fire time is known; every scan within CLOSE_RANGE, and those within RAM_RANGE, where a robot is about to ram; and the order opponents die in.

At the round's end the orchestrator folds each opponent's round into its block. Its finishing place counts the opponents only: with n opponents the first to die places n, the next n - 1, and any still alive when the round ends for Hadur place 1. The buffer is cleared at each round's start and holds at most MAX_OPPONENTS names (RES-2).
